brief_title: A Local Experiential Study With Sitagliptin (an Antihyperglycemic Drug) in 30 Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (0431-178)
official_title: An Open-label Study to Assess the Safety and Tolerability of JANUVIA (Sitagliptin) in 30 Patients With Type 2 Diabetes With Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Monotherapy

primary_outcomes.measure: Safety and Tolerability of Sitagliptin After 4 Weeks of Treatment

brief_summary: This study will assess, over a 4-week treatment period, the safety and efficacy of the addition of sitagliptin to metformin in participants with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) who failed to achieve glycemic control on metformin monotherapy.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants with T2DM failing metformin monotherapy
* Between the ages of 18 and 79

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants has a history of type 1 Diabetes Mellitus or ketoacidosis

inclusion.text: Participants with T2DM failing metformin monotherapy

exclusion.text: Participants has a history of type 1 Diabetes Mellitus or ketoacidosis
